ch31.note: The Kuomintang's internal disciplinary and oversight body, one of the party's highest organs, charged with supervising the conduct of members and officials.

The 'Pear Garden' (梨园) is the traditional name for the world of Chinese opera and its players, after the palace troupe of actors and musicians trained by the Tang emperor Xuanzong in his pear orchard.

The legislative branch of the Nationalist government's five-branch (五院) system, parallel to the Executive Yuan (the administrative branch, glossed earlier). Chen's correction turns on not confusing the two; Wang Jingwei's puppet regime aped the same structure.
Chen Gongbo (陈公博, 1892–1946), one of the leading figures of Wang Jingwei's collaborationist regime, who briefly headed it after Wang's death in 1944; he was tried and executed for treason in 1946.
